choice_points.<class>.<level> lists what a character choosing that class level picks. Entries with applies=first_class are only for a character's first class; applies=multiclass only when the class is added later; entries without applies always apply.
count is how many options to pick. option_source is a list of option names or a reference string; see reference_forms. filters narrow the options; see filters.
then maps an option to the extra picks it brings. alternatives are picks that can be taken instead of the entry (for example Blessed Warrior instead of a Fighting Style feat).
table_column marks a count derived from the class table rather than stated in the text; evidence is the feature text that grants it.
asi_or_feat and epic_boon use feats:qualified: the SRD grants the named feat (Ability Score Improvement) or category (Epic Boon) or another feat the character qualifies for.
Entries within a level are in dependency order (first-level traits, subclass, feats, feature picks, Expertise, cantrips, prepared spells); make the picks in that order.

swaps are later replacements. when is level_up, long_rest, short_rest or short_or_long_rest; count any means any number. For swaps with the same name and when, only the one with the highest from_level at or below the class level applies. requires_option limits a swap to characters who took that option.
feats[].choices and invocations[].choices are the picks made when the feat or invocation is taken (Pact of the Tome: each time its book appears, when=short_or_long_rest).
recommended is the SRD's own suggestion for that pick.

Evocation Savant: the Evoker gains a free Evocation spell at each class level that adds a new spell slot level after 3 (5, 7, ... 17). Whether the level 2 slots gained at Wizard level 3 also count is not stated; this file does not add one there.
Starting Equipment option_details are printed text; items inside an option (for example a Musical Instrument of your choice) remain the player's pick.
Text is ASCII: curly quotes became straight ones and dashes became hyphens.

Spells in that level range on the union of the class spell lists. In choice_points max_level is the class's highest spell slot level at that class level; max_level=slot (swaps only) means the character's current highest slot level for the class.

filters.proficient: Only skills the character has proficiency in (Rules Glossary, Expertise).
filters.no_expertise: Only skills the character does not already have Expertise in (Rules Glossary, Expertise).
filters.not_proficient: Only skills or tools the character lacks; a proficiency already held would add nothing.
filters.not_known: Only options the character does not already have from this or an earlier pick, unless the option is marked repeatable.
